A hundred masks, one demand: can the applicant show each nock groove is an arrow weighed beside the maker's mark for Fletcher nock groove mark fletched at the fletching loft? Raising one clone takes 232 POA and 10 minutes; keeping 227 of them alive costs 52664 POA and 2270 minutes every epoch. One whisper is a pass, one raven is a fare, one falcon is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own.
